summary: Compared to prior, current shows increased bilateral perihilar haze and denser bibasilar opacity with less distinct vascular margins, matched via hilar and diaphragm landmarks, consistent with worsening fluid overload/pulmonary vascular congestion.

findings.rationale: Prior shows relatively clear perihilar regions and only mild basilar haze; current shows denser, hazier perihilar markings and increased bibasilar opacity at the same anatomic levels. Multiple overlapping support lines and differing exposure/inspiration limit confidence.
